_source: Distilled from the offline ER guide (wiki.gg CC BY-SA + Fextralife, reworded). '(verify)' marks community claims not re-confirmed in-game. Aimed at players new to FromSoftware games.
universalTips: Vigor is king — aim for ~40 by mid-game. Most one-shot deaths are low Vigor, not low skill.
Bring a Spirit Ash (Mimic Tear or Black Knife Tiche) to split the boss's attention.
Status weapons win fights — Bleed and Frost chunk most early/mid bosses.
If a boss feels impossible, level up elsewhere and come back. That's the intended loop, not cheating.
Almost every boss is immune to Madness — skip Madness for boss damage.
Spend your runes BEFORE a hard boss; you drop them on death.

bosses.name: Margit, the Fell Omen
bring: Margit's Shackle (buy from Patches, Murkwater Cave, 5,000 runes) — stuns him twice in phase 1
Spirit Ashes (Lone Wolves)
Summon Sorcerer Rogier — gold sign outside the fog
tips: The game's first wall. If stuck, clear the Weeping Peninsula for levels and come back.
He delays his swings on purpose to bait early rolls — wait, then roll late.

bosses.name: Godrick the Grafted
bosses.greatRune: Godrick's Great Rune (+all attributes when active)
bring: Summon Nepheli Loux — sign inside the fog
Rotten Stray Spirit Ash (applies rot)
tips: Phase 2 he grafts a dragon head — stay at his side or behind, never in front of the fire.
Use the pillars and rubble to break line of sight.

bosses.name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
bosses.greatRune: Great Rune of the Unborn (enables respec — not a worn buff)
resists: Magic — very high; do NOT rely on sorcery
bring: A physical melee weapon
Spirit Ashes to interrupt her casting in phase 2
tips: Phase 1 is a puzzle, not a damage race: kill the 3 glowing singing students to drop her shield, then punish.
Phase 2: dodge TOWARD her to slip her glintstone spells.

bosses.name: Starscourge Radahn
bosses.greatRune: Radahn's Great Rune (raises max HP/FP/Stamina) — beating him also opens Nokron
weak: Scarlet Rot (melts him — Rotten Breath is the classic opener)
bring: Torrent — this is the one boss fight you ride
The NPC summon banners around the arena (re-summonable, no rune penalty)
tips: Gallop lateral to the opening arrow volley while closing the gap.
Keep re-summoning NPCs to tank his ranged barrages.

bosses.name: Morgott, the Omen King
bring: Margit's Shackle works on him too (twice, phase 1)
Summon Melina — sign at the fog
tips: Same delayed-swing baits as Margit — patient, late rolls.
Jump over his sweeping attacks and stick to his legs.

bosses.name: Fire Giant
bosses.location: Flame Peak, Mountaintops of the Giants
weak: weak points: chained leg (P1), wrists/eye/belly wound (P2) for double damage
resists: Fire — heavily; leave fire weapons home
bring: Torrent to keep pace
Mimic Tear or Black Knife Tiche; Alexander's summon if his quest is far enough
tips: Stay under and behind him, camera locked.
Phase 2 rolling fire wheel: sprint perpendicular, don't race it in a straight line.

bosses.name: Godskin Duo
weak: Sleep (huge — sleep one, gang the other)
bring: Sleep Pots / Sleep arrows / St. Trina's Torch
Mimic Tear; summon Recusant Bernahl (sign)
tips: They share ONE health pool — killing one just gets it revived; grind the shared bar down.
Use the pillars to fight one at a time.

bosses.name: Maliketh, the Black Blade
resists: Holy — heavily in phase 2; skip Holy damage there
bring: 40+ Vigor
A defensive Physick (e.g. Opaline Hardtear) — his red attacks cut max HP and apply a bleed-like DoT
Mimic Tear or Tiche
tips: Stay glued to him — his big combos whiff at point-blank; he's deadliest at mid-range.
Dodge late. Beating him is the world-change trigger — finish NPC quests first.

bosses.name: Godfrey, First Elden Lord / Hoarah Loux
bring: High Vigor
Spirit Ashes
tips: JUMP his ground-slam shockwaves — rolling often fails.
Phase 2 adds unblockable grabs with a clear wind-up: dodge late, into him.

bosses.name: Radagon / Elden Beast
weak: Radagon: Strike, Fire (full damage); Poison/Rot/Frost build; parryable
Elden Beast: Fire + physical; slow Bleed build
resists: Elden Beast: Holy (it spams holy at you)
bring: A Fire-infused weapon or Fire Grease
Haligdrake Talisman (cuts holy damage) for the Beast
40+ Vigor, Mimic Tear
tips: Both fights are back-to-back on one attempt — flasks do NOT refill between them, so save some. (verify exact behavior)
Radagon's hammer slams have long recovery — that's your punish window.
Elden Beast: sprint toward it constantly; run sideways through Elden Stars; roll the single homing star late.

bosses.name: Mohg, Lord of Blood
bosses.location: Mohgwyn Palace (via Consecrated Snowfield teleporter, or Varré's quest)
weak: Bleed + Frost (build slowly — he resists somewhat)
bring: Purifying Crystal Tear in your Physick — neutralizes most of the phase-2 Nihil ritual (the 3-count blood blast that otherwise drains you and heals him)
Mohg's Shackle (Subterranean Shunning-Grounds) — stuns him twice in phase 1
tips: Drink the Purifying-tear Physick before phase 2 triggers.
His bloodflame bleeds you over time — keep HP topped, don't stand in the fire pools.

bosses.name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
bosses.location: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree (fully optional — the hardest fight in the game)
weak: Bleed — procs can interrupt Waterfowl Dance
bring: High physical-negation talismans + a defensive Physick
Bloodhound's Step Ash of War (dodges Waterfowl Dance)
Mimic Tear — summons make her heal more, but they tank hits
tips: She heals on EVERY hit she lands — even blocked ones. Do not turtle behind a shield.
Waterfowl Dance is the #1 killer: run from the first two flurries, roll through the rest.
Phase 2 opens with a giant Scarlet Rot bloom — sprint out, then re-engage.

bosses.name: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
bosses.location: Grand Cloister, end of the Lake of Rot (Ranni's quest)
bring: Spirit Ashes (Latenna is great here) to hold aggro
tips: Don't lock on — free camera tracks its teleports and meteor barrage better.
Stay under it, near the head, where many attacks whiff.

bosses.name: Divine Beast Dancing Lion
weak: Physical — it staggers to sustained heavy hits
resists: Lightning/Frost/Wind — it wields all three, don't fight fire with fire
bring: Scadutree Blessing 2–4 before trying — fragments beat levels here
Summon Redmane Freyja's sign at the arena steps
tips: It's two guys in a lion suit, and it moves like it: stay glued to the body, not the head, and strafe with its spins.
Each element phase telegraphs — during the lightning dance, jump the ground surges; during frost, keep moving so the mist doesn't stack.

bosses.name: Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
weak: Parryable — her sword combos can be parried
resists: Magic and Fire — she channels both in phase 2
bring: Scadutree Blessing ≈5+ — she's the DLC's first real skill-check
A defensive Physick; NPC/ash summons to split her aggro
tips: Her long sword-chains are dodgeable at point-blank — mid-range is where she kills you.
Twin Moons (she rises with two moons): sprint away from the first two blasts, then JUMP the third — jumping beats rolling here.

bosses.name: Messmer the Impaler
weak: Stance-breakable during his grounded spear strings
resists: Fire — obviously; leave the flame builds home
bring: Scadutree Blessing ≈10 territory
Summon Hornsent's sign if you've kept his quest alive — story flavor included
tips: Nearly every combo ends in a long recovery — learn to wait out the string, then take your two hits.
Mid-fight he becomes the serpent: the giant dive is a sprint-away-then-roll, and his grab has a distinct slow wind-up — save your panic roll.

bosses.name: Bayle the Dread
resists: Lightning and Fire — he IS lightning and fire
bring: IGON. Summon his sign outside the arena if his quest is alive — the single best NPC summon moment in the game.
High stamina — you'll sprint a lot
tips: Fight under him at the left side; his head slams and breath mostly miss there.
Phase 2 opens with a massive lightning detonation — sprint OUT on the wind-up, then run straight back in.

bosses.name: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
weak: His openings are long — a patient melee dream
resists: Fire; Madness buildup from him is the real threat, not your damage
bring: Clarifying White Cured Meat / high Focus gear for the madness meter
Scadutree Blessing ≈12+
tips: Getting THERE is the fight: in the Abyssal Woods, crouch-walk and do not engage the Aged Ones — they cannot be fought conventionally.
In the arena he's one of the fairest duels in the DLC: every flame flurry has a clean pause at the end. Dodge late, punish once, reset.

bosses.name: Romina, Saint of the Bud
bosses.location: Church of the Bud (DLC, on the finale path)
resists: Scarlet Rot — she is its saint; your rot does nothing
bring: Boluses / Immunizing gear — her scythe strings stack rot fast
Scadutree Blessing ≈12–14
tips: She's a mobility fight: when she launches the centipede vault, sprint under the landing, don't backpedal.
Punish hard after her spinning rot bloom — it's her longest recovery.

bosses.name: Promised Consort Radahn
weak: His post-combo recoveries — the only real windows
resists: Holy (phase 2 especially); broadly tanky against everything
bring: Scadutree Blessing 18–20. Not optional for most builds.
Physical-negation talismans + a defensive Physick; Holy negation for phase 2
A summon (NPC signs or your Mimic) to buy breathing room
tips: The cross-slash: dodge INTO it diagonally — rolling away eats the second blade. Practice this one move; it's most of the fight.
Phase 2 adds light rain after his big swings — run TOWARD his back leg and the beams miss. The grab (he reaches with his off-hand) is a late dodge.
This is the hardest wall FromSoftware has built. Losing for a while is the intended experience — blessing up, don't be proud.

bosses.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
bosses.greatRune: Rykard's Great Rune (restores HP on kills)
weak: The Serpent-Hunter great spear (gimmick weapon at the arena entrance)
bring: The Serpent-Hunter — pick it up off the corpse at the entrance; normal weapons barely scratch him
A Mimic Tear also spawns holding one — trivializes the fight
tips: Spam the spear's heavy attacks and skill — it stuns and interrupts his skull-rain.
Stay out of the lava. Beating him CLOSES all Volcano Manor quests — finish those first.
